intro: Welcome to Blockchain Week – UNGA Edition 2026. Below is the official listing of premiere events taking place across the 10-day program in New York City. From space-themed fashion and high-signal networking to institutional forums, the flagship two-day conference, MAHA programming, BitcoinPalooza, the Washington Elite Investment Summit & Gala, and the International Day of Peace Concert, the week brings together builders, policymakers, investors, and innovators at the intersection of blockchain, AI, climate tech, and real-world impact.

events.title: Orbital Runway Kickoff
events.description: Hard Rock Cafe Times Square · Legends Bar + New York Room
events.details: A space-themed opening night featuring a live fashion show that blends futuristic design with blockchain culture. Presented in collaboration with Hooked-App, the evening launches Blockchain Week – UNGA Edition with immersive visuals, runway presentations, and networking under the theme of space exploration and digital frontiers.

events.title: Blockchain Week – UNGA Edition Meetup
events.description: High-signal networking and community gathering · Legends Bar, Hard Rock Cafe Times Square

events.title: Marquee Spotlight VVIP
events.description: Exclusive gathering for sponsors and media · On top of the Times Square billboard (the 3-sided marquee on the front of the Hard Rock Cafe)
events.details: Private VVIP experience with direct access to the iconic 3-sided Times Square marquee for branding, photos, and media coverage.

events.title: Multistakeholder Forum
events.description:
Leveraging Digital & Climate Tech to Advance the SDGs · United Nations Headquarters

We are involved in the planning, hosting and execution of this event with our partners. It is not included in any Blockchain Week – UNGA Edition tickets. Events at the UN cannot be sold for profit.

To apply for admittance (final decision by the UN): https://luma.com/SDG

events.title: CryptoMondays Wall Street
events.description: AI Panel — autonomous agents & AI × blockchain

events.title: Tech Tuesdays
events.description: Multiple high-level panels focused on emerging technology · Legends Bar + New York Room, Hard Rock Cafe Times Square
events.details: High-signal networking and panel discussions bringing together innovators, builders, and industry leaders.

events.title: MAHA Wednesday
events.description: Special evening programming following Day 1 of the main conference · Hard Rock Cafe Times Square
events.details: Continued discussions, networking, and curated sessions that build on the themes of the first conference day.

events.title: BitcoinPalooza
events.description: Official after party of Blockchain Week – UNGA Edition · Hard Rock Cafe Times Square
events.details: Multiple live performances, select talks, and high-energy entertainment. The premier celebration closing out the second day of the flagship conference.

events.title: Washington Elite Investment Summit & Gala
events.description: Returning for the 4th year as the flagship event of Blockchain Week – UNGA Edition · Hard Rock Main Theatre
events.details: The premier black-tie summit and gala bringing together investors, family offices, institutional leaders, and decision-makers. A high-caliber evening of deal-making, networking, and celebration that has become the signature closing highlight of the week.

events.title: Pause the World for Peace
events.description: 24th Annual LIVE CLEAN ENERGY International Day of Peace Concert · Times Square
events.details: In collaboration with PaulSladkus. A special daytime concert celebrating peace and clean energy, closing out Blockchain Week – UNGA Edition in the heart of Times Square.

conference.title: Flagship Conference · September 16–17
conference.summary: The two-day Blockchain Week – UNGA Edition Conference takes place in the Hard Rock Main Theatre. Programming spans Bitcoin, policy, institutional infrastructure, AI, energy, space, and real-world impact.

days.label: Day 1 — Wednesday, September 16 · from 9am
days.focusAreas: Bitcoin foundations & adoption, regulatory & policy frameworks, institutional infrastructure, and the intersection of blockchain with energy systems.
days.description: Sessions explore institutional readiness, capital markets, compliance architecture, and the evolving role of Bitcoin in global finance. The day sets the stage for deeper discussions on infrastructure and real-world deployment.

days.label: Day 2 — Thursday, September 17 · from 9am
days.focusAreas: Artificial intelligence × blockchain, space technology, climate and energy applications, real-world assets (RWA), and measurable impact aligned with the Sustainable Development Goals.
days.description: Programming highlights autonomous systems, tokenization of real-world assets, space-economy use cases, and pathways from pilot projects to scalable institutional adoption.
